m: 1. नस् encl. form for acc. gen. dat. pl. of the 1st pers. pron. (Pāṇ. viii, 1, 21), us, of us, to us; in Veda changeable into णस् (4, 27; 28).
नस्, [cf. Zd. na, our; Gk. νῶϊ, νώ; Lat. nos, nos-ter; Old Lat. dat. nis.]

2. नस् cl. 1. Ā. (Dhātup. xvi, 26) नसते (aor. Pot. नसीमहि, RV. ii, 16, 8; pf. नेसे; fut. नसिता Gr.) to approach, resort to, join, copulate (esp. as husband and wife), RV.; to be crooked or fraudulent, Dhātup.
नस् [cf. Gk.νέ(σ)ομαι, να(σ)ίω, νόσ-τος; Goth. ga-nizan, nas-jan; Angl.Sax. genësan; HGerm. ginësan, genesen.]
3. नस् or नास् f. (the strong stem occurs only in du. नासा, RV. ii, 39, 6, the weak stem only in नसा, नसि, नसोस् [cf. Pāṇ. vi, 1, 63] and in comp.) the nose, RV.; AV.; VS.; TS.; BhP.
नस् [cf. नासा, नासिका; Lat. nas-turcium, nāres; Lith. nósis; Slav. nosǔ; Germ. Nase; Angl.Sax. nosu; Eng. nose, nostril = nose-thrill, nose-hole.]
a: नस् — {c1c} A. (नसते) Ved. 1 To approach, go towards. --2 To copulate. --3 To be crooked or curved, to bend.
नस् — f. The nose (a word optionally substituted for नासिका after acc. dual). --Comp. --क्षुद्र a. smallnosed.
